title: Bleeding Beacon
lyrics:
heavy legs,
hands bleeding
eye half shut,
bearly breathing,

bones creekin,. cracking,. popping
"is that all you got?" i aint stoppin

you get the call
like a beacon
 to a boat
the only way, 
your the goat

"will you play tonight"?
"why,... YES.., i will, if you like!"

"No" is not a part of my vocabulary

Im a YESSS....,kinda womannnn.

we're short, wanna play

YES!

too, many, wanna sit

YES!

wanna put on some tunes

YES!




double over, singles time

YES!

wanna play with me

Im a YESSS....,kinda womannnn

play on the ball was in

Im a YESSS....,kinda womannnn

come play with me
say YES

Im a YESSS....,kinda womannnn
